title: 6 side effects of *going to the gym*

items.head: You lose interest in flaky people
items.sub: Excuses start sounding loud once you stop making them.

items.head: You're asleep by 10PM
items.sub: No melatonin. Your body just asks for it.

items.head: Old shirts get tight
items.sub: Shoulders first, then the sleeves. Time to shop.

items.head: Bad days last 45 minutes
items.sub: One hard session fixes what venting never did.

items.head: Junk food stops being worth it
items.sub: You know what it costs you in the next workout.

items.head: Opinions stop landing
items.sub: Hard to feel small when you just pulled 140 kg.

text: You stop needing motivation and *start missing it* on rest days.
